description: Verify a BLOOM-XCH settlement certificate offline: canonical digest, certificate id, round hash chain, Ed25519 signature and both AP2 credential proofs. Keys come from the issuer's Agent Card (fetched from the certificate's issuer URL unless you pass the card).

agentCard.description: The issuer's Agent Card (object, JSON or URL). Omit to fetch it from the certificate.

receipt.description: The certificate, or any JSON containing it under `certificate`.

name: verify_receipt
title: Verify a BLOOM-XCH receipt
